items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I never seen that power that Freddie had.

ctx.x: I've seen in so many Jazz books that Kid Thomas is the nearest thing to Freddie Keppard. Now, you've heard them both play. Who would you say...
[CHUCKLES] Kid Thomas... I never heard... Maybe he was capable of doing it. But I never seen that power that Freddie had.
See, me, I don't know how they come about that. I know Kid Thomas' playing and I know Freddie's playing.
